detail.longDescription: Okay, what bozo checked in Meta's employee info into Github?!?! "added to github by mistake" LOL. "...Meta Says Hackers Took Code, Personal Data of 1,500 in GitHub Breach... Meta is notifying roughly 1,500 people, most of them employees in the US, that their personal information was impacted after hackers got into some of the company’s GitHub repositories..,.. That personal data had been added to the repositories by mistake and should not have been there, as storing it on GitHub went against company policy. Meta has not said what types of personal information were involved. ,.." https://www. securityweek.com/meta-says-hac kers-took-code-personal-data-of-1500-in-github-breach/ # github # cybersecurity # meta
